snippet.title: Demidoff Corp — Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Targem Games announces Demidoff Corp — 2D metroidvania based on the Ural folk

Our studio’s new project combines atmospheric exploration, classic souls-like mechanics, and a distinctive setting inspired by Ural folklore.

Welcome to the mystical world of Ural folk tales, where you must uncover the secrets held within Demidov’s Tower. Explore the historical Ural with its icy mining tunnels, mysterious lakes, dense forests, and Demidov’s estates, which harbor many unsolved mysteries.

While the factories continue to emit smoke day and night, a magical affliction is beginning to spread throughout the region. You play as a fluffy retired royal agent who sets off on an urgent mission to the ends of the earth to investigate what is going on in Demidov’s estates and report the whole truth to the Tsar. 

📢 Join the Demidoff Corp playtest! Visit the game’s Steam page, add it to your wishlist, and sign up for the playtest. Testing will begin very soon, and you’ll receive a notification when it goes live.

🎮 Demidoff Corp on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5089550/Demidoff_Corp/

The game is scheduled to release in early 2027. Over the coming months, we’ll share more details and launch a demo. Follow us on social media so you don’t miss the announcements, and roll up your sleeves — battles await!
